info.name: Kyverno Policy Reporter ClusterPolicyReports Policies API

items.docs: Returns a list of configured notification targets such as Slack, Teams, Loki, Elasticsearch, and others. Each target entry includes its name, minimum priority filter, and enabled sources.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by policy source (e.g., kyverno, trivy)

items.docs: Returns a list of policies with result counts grouped by status. Supports filtering by namespace, source, and category. Each entry includes counts of pass, fail, warn, error, and skip results.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by policy source (e.g., kyverno, trivy)

items.docs: Returns a list of policy rule names that have results across all namespaces. Can be filtered by namespace and source to narrow the results.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by policy source (e.g., kyverno, trivy)

items.docs: Returns a list of policy category names used to group related policies. Categories are defined in policy metadata and may include values such as Pod Security Standards or Best Practices.
